statement: The recorded load value of none is neither safe nor correct for this case, as feeder F-12 is actively carrying 2.4 megawatts to Mercy Hospital while the backup line F-14 remains open.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "The recorded load value of none is neither safe nor correct... F-12 is actively carrying 2.4 megawatts," directly contradicting the record.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
